subject.title: [bug] 10 skills stuck in pending_checks after staged prepublication pipeline deployment

question: How should ClawHub restore blocked publishes without unintentionally weakening the prepublication security gate?
rationale: The issue is an active publish outage, but the linked mitigation changes who can bypass TruffleHog and ClawScan; that security boundary needs maintainer intent rather than automated repair.

options.title: Fix worker and drain attempts
options.body: Investigate production `publishAttempts` and worker logs, repair the claim/finalize path, and manually retry or drain affected attempts while keeping prepublication checks required by default.

options.title: Allow a scoped emergency bypass
options.body: Accept a narrowly scoped maintainer/operator-controlled bypass if immediate restore is more urgent than full worker repair, with auditability and follow-up removal or hardening.

options.title: Merge caller bypass
options.body: Permit publishers to opt out with a payload flag as proposed in the open PR, accepting the risk that ordinary API callers can skip the prepublication gate during outages.

recommendation.title: Fix worker and drain attempts
recommendation.body: Investigate production `publishAttempts` and worker logs, repair the claim/finalize path, and manually retry or drain affected attempts while keeping prepublication checks required by default.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen authored and merged the staged publish and worker changes, so they have the strongest history signal for the security/operation tradeoff.
